title: fix: #5994 #5995 #5996 align remaining live inline semantics
issueTitle: [Bug] [CommonMark] Live emphasis flanking misclassifies Unicode symbols
why: Issue #5996 says a bare www domain followed by a sentence-ending period stays plain text on the buggy build, while the fixed build renders the domain as a link and leaves the period outside it; the other two issues need a non-ASCII key (#5994) or invisible whitespace (#5995) and cannot be checked on screen.
